decisionSummary: Every credential category requires owner confirmation. Production remains blocked until the category is ROTATED, or a time-bounded risk acceptance is recorded and verified in the test environment.

categories.name: 数据库账号
categories.testControl: Use a test-only account scoped to kaipai_test; prohibit credentials with write access to kaipai_prod.
categories.verificationRequired: Read back the effective schema target and account scope without recording credential values.

categories.name: Nacos 账号
categories.testControl: Use separate test dataId access and do not grant the test runtime permission to publish production dataIds.
categories.verificationRequired: Verify dataId and namespace access using redacted summaries only.

categories.name: 腾讯云/COS 密钥
categories.testControl: Use a separate private test bucket and deny test credentials access to the production bucket.
categories.verificationRequired: Compare bucket identity and effective policy without writing full object URLs or key material to records.

categories.name: 微信小程序 AppSecret
categories.testControl: Use the approved test/experience-version configuration and keep AppSecret out of builds, logs, and candidate records.
categories.verificationRequired: Confirm presence and source category only; never record the value or transmit it through a command argument.

categories.name: 短信、实名和 AI provider Token
categories.testControl: Disable real side effects or restrict calls to explicit test allowlists, fixed verification codes, and bounded quotas.
categories.verificationRequired: Verify the provider mode, allowlist, and quota state without recording token values.

categories.name: 后台 smoke 账号凭据
categories.testControl: Read the password from KAIPAI_ADMIN_SMOKE_PASSWORD at runtime; do not place it in source, command history, or evidence.
categories.verificationRequired: Record only login result, account alias, and environment.

categories.name: 发布 SSH/bootstrap 凭据
categories.testControl: Use pinned known_hosts and explicit environment inputs; do not use repository fallback values or automatically accept host keys.
categories.verificationRequired: Verify host key and helper healthcheck only after separate remote authorization.

nextAction: Obtain owner decisions and test-environment verification inputs; execute no production rotation or remote helper sync in this record.
